title: A skill is a folder
text: Before it works. This one is contact center/android, the skill. MD file holds the full instruction set in plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it then acts. The file is the program. The pipeline sits in the step section.

title: How the skill works — read, execute, return
text: Claude reads each step in order then runs it. Linear, no branching unless a step says so.

title: The interesting constraint: one SDK, native Android
text: The scope is specific. Contact center/android covers the Zoom contact center SDK for native Android apps, chat, video, the virtual agent, scheduled callback integrations, campaign mode, service life cycle, and rejoin handling.
